title: Add customer story links to quickstart READMEs
author: Ben Carter
description:
Context: As part of the Customer Reference Program launch, we want PLG users who land in quickstarts to quickly find real production examples (architecture + outcomes) without needing to talk to Sales first. This PR adds a small, consistent “Customer stories” section to the top-level quickstart READMEs and lightly tightens a few CTA lines so the new links read naturally.

What changed: (1) Add a “Customer stories” section with links to the new docs site entry point for case studies; (2) standardize link text (“Customer stories” vs “Case studies”) across quickstarts; (3) minor copy edits in the intro paragraphs to avoid repeating “quickstart” and to keep the flow into Setup.

Notes: Links are intentionally pointing at the stable entry page (not specific customer pages) so we don’t create churn while individual stories move from internal drafts to public publish. Final URL is the one created in ENG-4921.

Checklist: - [x] Links render correctly on GitHub - [x] Local markdown lint - [x] Link checker passes - [x] No product claims added in quickstarts

review_conversation:
Soojin Lee: Can we avoid the phrase “case studies” in quickstarts and keep it “Customer stories” to match the nav naming? Also please make sure we’re not linking to any draft pages that still include unapproved metrics.

Ben Carter (author): Yep — updated all headings + link text to “Customer stories” and switched links to the entry page only (no customer-specific pages).

Tyler Benson: Link checker is failing on private-deployment/README.md (looks like a relative link without protocol). Can you standardize to the full docs URL so GitHub renders it cleanly?

Ben Carter (author): Fixed and re-ran; markdown-link-check now green.

Markus Klein: Minor nit: in dedicated-capacity README, the “Customer stories” section sits before the prerequisites and pushes setup down. Can we keep it short (1–2 lines) so it doesn’t feel like marketing?

Ben Carter (author): Shortened the description line and removed the extra sentence. It’s now a single bullet + link across all READMEs.

Soojin Lee: Approved after the wording tweak. Thanks.
release_notes: Docs-only: quickstarts now link to the Customer stories entry page to help users find production examples.
